title: Supplementary code for: Topological Certificates of Redundant Coverage for Cortical Electrode Arrays
description: Python implementation of the k-shadow certificate and every computation reported in the paper: exact nerves of disk and geodesic footprint families, k-shadow and subdivision complexes with GF(2) Betti numbers, the redundancy barcode, the cortical-surface benchmark on the FieldTrip colin27 template, the optimal-coverage design search, and the analysis of real contact failures on a 64-channel EEG cap (OpenNeuro ds003775 v1.2.1), with an exact arrangement check of the certificate. v1.4.0 adds the pre-specified signal-level test run on all 152 usable recordings (does redundancy predict how well a dropped channel is rebuilt?), exploratory analyses of what it can and cannot say about topology, a margin-preserving null and correlation length for spatially correlated contact failures, a repaired versioned download of the dataset, and the amsart manuscript with every number generated from the result files.
